webhooks.intro: A webhook calls a web address when a transcript is finished or has failed, so tools like n8n or Zapier can continue. The call contains no transcript, only the job's details.

webhooks.verifyIntro: Every call carries the headers X-Webhook-Id, X-Webhook-Event, X-Webhook-Timestamp and X-Webhook-Signature. Compute the HMAC-SHA256 of the timestamp, a dot and the raw body with your secret, compare it in constant time and reject old timestamps. Failed deliveries are repeated with growing delays; use X-Webhook-Id to ignore duplicates.
